en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph, likely from the early 20th century, depicting a wide, tree-lined avenue leading directly to a large, stately building in the background. The trees on either side form a canopy, and the path is bordered by low fences. There are a few people visible walking or standing along the path. The building at the end appears to be a manor or small palace, characterized by its symmetry and prominent central entrance.
